text: Great ok thanks for that! now, i was wondering if you look at our current grass blade approach and palm for the tree approach, could you try your hand at doingn some grassy flower patches, so the same grass, with flowers on the ends or something
resolution: Added a new grass-lane flora swatch, Flower Grass, that renders as the existing lush grass blade bed plus a deterministic companion batch of small colored flower heads at blade-tip height. The editor iso preview draws the new flower batch through WorldStatics, and the compiled bake emits the flower heads with the existing sphere shape so compiled output stays in parity with the editor preview. Added a focused population test proving Flower Grass emits both blades and flower heads while normal grass does not.
